content: xdg-su wrapper = aports package content (2026-11-25): niri-base-config ships /usr/bin/xdg-su. FHS+abuild: packages must NEVER touch /usr/local (abuild hard check 'Packages must not put anything under /usr/local' — live-verified); unowned /usr/bin paths = the distro-correct home. The old vendor fallback exec /usr/bin/xdg-su was dead code (NO Alpine package ships xdg-su) AND a self-loop at that path -> hard error. Installer Go: xdgsu.go deleted.

xdg-su = STANDALONE aports package (2026-11-25, owner correction): a tool that does one thing is NOT config — never fold into a *-config family package (set-permissions/assemble-cmdline precedent). xdg-su 0.1.0 ships /usr/bin/xdg-su (unowned Alpine path; FHS: abuild bans /usr/local in packages). niri-base-config 0.3.0 = configs only + depends feralos-branding xdg-su (the DE installs pull tools/staging through the shared layer deps, no list entries).

xdg-su standalone package CONFIRMED live: flagship 141/141 — xdg-su 0.1.0-r0 (dep of niri-base-config 0.3.0-r0) installed, wrapper asserted. Round closed: xdg-su tool = own package per ADR-013 tool/config separation.
